component.name: Ultnas
component.summary: Protect text files from invisible-character tampering

description.p: Some Unicode characters render as nothing at all, or silently reorder the text around them, so a file can change meaning without looking any different. Ultnas watches the files you choose and undoes any write that slips these characters in.
This app is the desktop side of Ultnas:

ul.li: See whether protection is running, and start or stop it
Track and untrack files and folders
See exactly what a pending edit changes, with invisible characters shown, and approve it
Get a notification when Ultnas strips characters, restores a file, or quarantines a namespace
